history_full:
Mizorama ‘Kristian Thalai Pawl’ la din hma, hmun thenkhatah thalaite a hranga an inkhawm thin tawh hnu khan Sihphir Kohhrana thalaite pawhin kum 1951 khan thalai inkhawm a hrana neih an duh thu Kohhran Committee-ah an thlen a, Kohhran Committee thu hetiang hian kan hmu:
“Thalai inkhawm rawtna a lo lût a, ngun taka kan ngaihtuahin tulin kan hria a, June thla chhung Chairman Ztu. Chhawna. Programme kal zel erawh chu ziaktu kutah dah a ni”
(Kohhran Minute - Thurel No. 5 of dt. 6.5.1951).

Hemi kum atang hian Sihphir Kohhran-ah thalai inkhawm chu a hranpaa neih a lo ni ve ta a ni. Thalai inkhawm chu Kohhran Committee hnuaia awmin, pawl ang pawh ni lovin an nei chho ve tan ta a. Mahse Kohhran Committee hnuaia an kal dan chu buaithlâk deuh leh tha lo zâwka hriatna a awm a ni ang, Kohhran Committee-a an thu thlen chu Kohhranin hetiangin a rél a:
“Thalai inkhawm hi a hranpaa Committee neih ni se, engkimah Kohhran tan thatna a awm zawk ang e” tih leh “‘Chairman te pawh Thalaiin chang se’ tih a lo lût a, ngun taka kan ngaihtuahin KH Committee kutah vek la ni se kan ti” (Kohhran Minute – Thurel No. 4 of dt. 1.7.1951).

Chutiang rawtna a lo awm tâkah chuan thalai rilru leh dinhmun hrethiam tak chungin Kohhran Committee pawhin an thu thlen an tidanglam leh a:
“Thalai inkhawm hi Committee hran ni lovin, a vawngtu leh Chairman kan ruatsak a, hun ruattu dang awm lovin an kutah a awm tawh ang.
(1) Lalzauva (2) Vanlalsiama
(3) Suakphunga (4) Raldothanga
Upa Vawmsata hian August thla chhung chu Chairman tlang zel se kan ti”
(Kohhran Minute-Thurel No. 1 of dt. 29.7.1951).

Heng an mi ruatte hian hun eng emaw chen chu thalai inkhawm pawh an neihpui thin a. Mahse, eng hun lai emaw atangin thalai inkhawm chu 1953 September thla thleng a zuih ral leh niin a lang. Chuvang chuan 1953 September thla khan thalai inkhawm chu rawt thar leh a ni a. Inkhawm hun atan kar tin Thawhlehni zan leh Inrinni zan an duh thu Kohhran Committee-ah an thlen leh a. Kohhran Committee chuan thalai inkhawm chu rem tiin, inkhawm hun erawh chu Thawhlehni zan chauh ni se an ti a. Hruaitu, thusawitu leh tantu pawh thalaite kutah an dah ta vek a. Hotu atan Hmartawna, Suakphunga, Dothanga, VL Siama leh Vanhnuaithanga te an ruat a. (Kohhran Minute- Thurel No. 1 of dt.27.9.1953). Kohhran pawhin thalaite zalenna a pe zau ta hle mai. Kohhran hruaituten thalaite an hrethiam hle tih a lang thei.

Hetianga thalai inkhawm a hranga a awm tâ hi Kohhran mi thenkhat chuan ‘hotu nih châk’ tiin an helh deuh hle a. Mahse Kohhran leh khawtlang tana a thatna a lo lan chhuah tak zel avangin, thalai inkhawm pawh tluang takin a kal chho ta zel a ni.
Tichuan kum 1955 khan Inrinni zana inkhawm an duh thu Kohhran Committee-ah an thlen leh a, hetiang hian Kohhran Committee thu kan hmu leh:
“Kohhran thalai pawlin Inrinni zan hi thalai inkhawm zan atana an rawn dilna chu kan remti” (Kohhran Minute -Thurel No. 3 of 16 1.1955)
Hemi atang hi chuan Thawhlehni zana inkhawm thin kha Inrinni zanah sawn a lo ni ta a. Hemi hnu lawka Kohhran Committee-a “Kristian Thalai Pawl Conference kan vengah hian ko ila” tih Kohhrana an thlen pawh remtihsak a ni nghe nghe (Kohhran Minute - Thurel No. 3 of dt. 23.1.1955).
Sihphir Branch KTP din dan :
Kan hriat theuh angin ni 22.2.1954-ah Central KTP din a ni a. Hemi kum la la hian kan bial (Nisapui Pastor Bial) chhunga Kohhran thenkhat - Mualkhang leh Nisapui-ah pawh Branch KTP a ding ve nghâl a. Nimahsela, Sihphir Kohhran-ah erawh chuan KTP hi a ding ve mai lo.

Bial KTP (Nisapui bial) chu ni 5.3.1955 khan a ding a, hemi hnu lawk hian Sihphir Kohhranah pawh KTP chu mumal takin a ding ve ta a ni (Pu Hmartawna, Leader hmasa ber sawi) tih chu Sihphira KTP din hun kan hriatna hnaivai ber a lo ni ta a. Bial KTP din hun, ni 5.3.1955 hi Inrinni a ni a, hemi zawh chiah chawlhkar Pathianni hmang (ni 11-13.3.1955) hian Lungmuat Kohhran-ah Bial inkhawmpui neih a ni a.

Sihphir Kohhrana thalaite pawh eng emaw zat kal vein, hemi chawlhkara KTP din hun tur atana an hun remchang neih, ni 12.3.1955 Inrinni zan thalai inkhawm hunah hi chuan KTP an la din theih loh hmel a. Tin, “He Bial Inkhawmpuiah hian Bial chhunga Kohhran thenkhatah KTP a din tawh thute sawiin, la din ve lo Kohhranah pawh din ve ni se tiin kan inchah,” tiin Upa R. Saptawna, he inkhawmpuia Acting Secretary (Jr.) chuan a sawi. 
Heta KTP la din ve lohna Kohhran a tih zingah hian Sihphir Kohhran pawh tel ve in, he Bial Inkhawmpui zawha thalaiho hun remchang neih hmasak ber, ni 19.3.1955 Inrinni zan, thalai inkhawm zan hian Kristian Thalai Pawl chu din a lo ni ve ta a ni.
